thread.document:
Dear students, 

We have more more last minute resource that may help you --- we have draft notes ready for the optimization module. Nothing in these notes is new and you do not have to use these to study. Everything here already exists in the Lectures and Lecture Slides. I want to appreciate the efforts of  TA Kevin Franz for helping scribe many parts as well as student Jameson Liu whose script we built on to help with some of the content writing. The faculty have edited all of the notes carefully and also done some of the writing, but nonetheless these are still a draft and may have bugs. Please let us know if you find issues and we will patch them right away. 



Please don't think of this as 'one more thing you have to do', only use them if they are helpful to you. You will not miss anything by not looking at these. 



Best of luck!
